text:
idk what the answer is other than this: 
- props are their own single file
- they live in one file
- there is one file for each prop
- solo filo
resolution: Deleted the dead 'component-as-source' prop subsystem: 15 bespoke render components in render3d/props/ (Ball, Bush, Dumpster, Fence, FireHydrant, Furniture, Mailbox, Payphone, Rock, StopSign, StreetFurniture, StreetLight, TrafficLight, Tree, WallDecor) plus mineProp.ts and mineProp.test.ts — 17 files. They held a second copy of every prop's geometry, superseded by the single recipe source (propRecipes/resolve.ts -> resolvePropParts) that both DataProp render and the worldGeometry bake read. The 8 fully-dead components had zero imports; the other 7 + mineProp.ts were referenced only by the self-test. StreetSign kept (live, route-plate texture), as were signFace/place/DataProp/ImportedProp. No dangling imports; render path bundles green. This is the first checkpoint of the larger one-prop-one-file refactor (req_0846/0848/0849 still in doing).
